en_title: GTA 6's Map Will Open Up Relatively Early and Let You Explore Freely, Developers Are Still Discovering New Parts of the World
subtitle: 不必跟着剧情解锁地图
opus_summary: Rockstar确认，《GTA6》地图将在较早阶段开放，玩家不必随剧情逐步解锁。开发者至今仍在发现新地点，室内空间数量较旗下其他作品高出一个数量级。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's world won't be blocked off by story progression, Rockstar confirms.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar确认，《GTA6》的世界不会因剧情进度而限制玩家探索。

paragraphs.en: In a new preview from Edge magazine (as relayed by the podcast GTA VI O'Clock ), Rockstar Games confirmed a ton of new details about GTA 6. One of the big bits revealed was that GTA 6's map will open up relatively early. In some GTA games, like GTA 4, the game forces you to progress through its story before you can access the entire map. GTA 4's Liberty City uses police blockades on bridges to make sure the world only expands as Niko continues his journey. That changed in GTA 5, as you could go wherever your heart desired once the game's tutorials were finished.
paragraphs.cn: 据播客《GTA VI O'Clock》转述，Rockstar在《Edge》杂志最新的前瞻报道中确认了大量《GTA6》的新细节。其中一条重要消息是，《GTA6》的地图会在游戏较早阶段开放。在《GTA4》等部分《GTA》作品中，玩家必须推进剧情，才能探索整张地图。《GTA4》中的自由城通过警方封锁桥梁来限制通行，随着尼科的旅程推进，玩家才能逐步探索更多区域。《GTA5》改变了这一点，玩家完成教学后，就能随心所欲地前往任何地方。

paragraphs.en: It seems like GTA 6 will be similar, as Edge's story confirms that the state of Leonida will open up relatively early on. Of course, there will likely be some initial story bits to introduce the characters and mechanics before you can go wherever you want. So, if you wish to head north and see the top of the map at the start of the game, you can do so. Of course, the story itself will take you to a lot of places around the map as you experience it, but you won't be chained to Vice City for the first 10 hours if you don't want to be.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》似乎也会采用类似的做法，《Edge》的报道确认，雷奥尼达州会在游戏较早阶段开放。当然，在玩家能够自由行动之前，游戏很可能会先安排一些剧情，介绍角色和玩法机制。因此，如果你想在游戏初期一路向北，看看地图最北端的风景，也可以这么做。当然，随着剧情推进，故事本身也会带你走访地图上的许多地方，但只要你不愿意，就不必在前10个小时里一直待在罪恶都市。

paragraphs.en: Red Dead Redemption 2 also largely lets the player freely explore the map, but there was one area that they couldn't visit until the end of the game: the entire map from the first Red Dead Redemption. While there wasn't as much to see and do there, it was a fun surprise that almost doubled the scope of the game's map. If players tried to go there before the story was ready, they would be shot and killed by snipers.
paragraphs.cn: 《荒野大镖客：救赎2》同样允许玩家自由探索地图上的大部分区域，但有一片区域要到游戏尾声才能前往，那就是初代《荒野大镖客：救赎》的整张地图。虽然那里可看、可玩的内容没有那么多，但这个惊喜依然令人欣喜，让游戏地图的范围几乎扩大了一倍。如果玩家试图在剧情推进到相应阶段之前前往那里，就会遭到狙击手射杀。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, the first Red Dead Redemption game prevented the player from visiting Mexico until John Marston's journey took him there. It seems like GTA 6 will give players a lot of freedom off the bat... and it may take a while before you see anything. Rockstar North co-studio head Aaron Garbut also confirmed that he's still discovering new locations in Leonida.
paragraphs.cn: 同样，在初代《荒野大镖客：救赎》中，玩家也必须等到约翰·马斯顿的旅程推进至墨西哥，才能前往那里。《GTA6》似乎从一开始就会给予玩家很大的自由……但你可能得花上好一阵子才能看遍各处。Rockstar North联合负责人Aaron Garbut也确认，他至今仍会在雷奥尼达州发现新的地点。

paragraphs.en: Part of that comes from how dense the game is, with Garbut noting that there are "an order of magnitude more interiors" compared to other Rockstar titles, and all of them have been handcrafted with an exceptional level of detail.
paragraphs.cn: 这部分得益于游戏内容的密集程度。Garbut指出，与Rockstar的其他作品相比，本作的室内空间数量「高出一个数量级」，而且全部由手工打造，细节精细程度极高。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5.
